ov: قلب الوحش (الإنجليزية: Heart of the Beast) هو فلم حركة ومغامرات أمريكي، أخرجه ديفيد آير وكتب سيناريوه كاميرون ألكسندر. يؤدي براد بيت بطولة الفلم، ويشارك كذلك في إنتاجه. صدر في 25 سبتمبر 2026.
plotEn:
Retired Special Forces Command Sergeant Major James Belmont and his combat dog Odin, both suffering from PTSD and nightmares, land their Cessna Skywagon on a remote Alaskan lake and camp overnight. While exploring the surrounding forest, James cautiously encounters Watkins, an outgoing stranger who sets up camp nearby. They talk late into the night, James shares stories of the heroism and sacrifices that Odin has made in his duty. The next morning, Watkins departs, leaving James a book in exchange for a Belgian ale he had taken from the camp overnight. He highlights a particular passage in the book, “he had survived the worst the world could throw at him. He had known the cruelty of men, but he had survived. And love for man had taken root in his heart.”
James and Odin depart by plane, but James suffers a heart attack mid-flight and crashes into a body of water. Odin is thrown out of the plane during the crash. James finds him nearby, weak but alive, then returns to the sunken wreckage to salvage his gear. Once Odin recovers enough to travel, the pair begin hiking toward civilization, approximately 58 miles (93 kilometers) away by James's calculations.
During their trek, they encounter a grizzly bear.  James instructs Odin to not make eye contact or antagonize the bear, and it retreats.
